faqs.question: How do I book a car with New Gen Auto?
faqs.answer: Choose your service and car on this page, fill in your date, time and pickup details, then tap "Send Booking on WhatsApp". You can also message or call us directly on +94 72 480 5594.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to rent an EV in Colombo?
faqs.answer: Self-drive AION V rentals are LKR 12,000 per day. Chauffeur service and airport pickups start from LKR 8,000.

faqs.question: Can I rent with a driver instead of driving myself?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our private chauffeur service gives you a professional driver for business or private trips.

faqs.question: Do you offer airport pickups and drop-offs?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer reliable airport pickup and drop-off. Send us your flight details when you book.

faqs.question: Are your cars insured?
faqs.answer: Every vehicle is fully insured, inspected and cleaned before each trip.

faqs.question: Are you available 24/7?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team is available 24/7 on WhatsApp and phone.
